camera:
DSi camera test
v1.1.0
NDS

A small camera utility that previews the DSi’s cameras and saves 640×480 PNG photos.

Hardware: DSi / DSi XL · DSi mode only

Setup & prerequisites
Copy dsi-camera.nds onto the DSi SD card and open it with a launcher that provides DSi-mode camera and SD access.
Saved photos use /DCIM/100DSI00/IMG_####.PNG. Keep existing photos and available space on the card.

The .nds extension does not make this a DS / DS Lite camera app: it requires the DSi hardware cameras. The publisher supplies a separate CIA asset for another installation route; it is not included here.
